value.rationale: Theorem 7 is the paper's stated global-attractivity result for the positive coexistence equilibrium. Proving that its hypothesis set is empty changes its scientific interpretation from a restrictive sufficient condition to a criterion that certifies no parameter regime at all. This explains why the source could not exhibit a satisfying numerical example and identifies a concrete target for any corrected global-attractivity analysis.
